Game Overview

In Blue Rabbit, the core idea is straightforward: hop into adventure with Blue Rabbit. Collect gold coins while dodging sneaky cats and frogs. Restore your health by finding hidden hearts to keep the excitement alive. Can you master the challenge and stay in the game?

How to Play

Playing Blue Rabbit comes down to a simple loop. Hop into adventure with Blue Rabbit! Collect gold coins while dodging sneaky cats and frogs. Restore your health by finding hidden hearts to keep the excitement alive. Can you master the challenge and stay in the game?
